comments: A very nice and clean apartment in the center of Madrid. From there You can easily reach a lots of places to visit. Jose Pablo and his team are very kind and helpful. Suggested!

Cute little apartment right in the heart of Madrid. Clean and well-organized. Perfect for a stay when you spend most of your time exploring the city. The hosts are very kind and provides valuable information.

Great location, great hosts, and great apartment with just enough space you need, especially if you are going to be out and enjoying Madrid. Rut and Oscar were great hosts. Between our limited Spanish and their limited English - we did just fine!

The house is perfect and the hosts are very kind and they like to give suggestions about Madrid! The flat is how it appears in pictures, small but very very nice and very very clean!!!!Good job Rut and Oscar..see you next time in Madrid! :)
Great little apartment and in a fantastic location. It was easy to find. The space is small but very well used and friendly. It is on 5th floor and no elevator. I loved it
Nice modern flat right in the center of Madrid, 5 minute walk from the palace and right next to all the great restaurants.

Everything as described! Communication before and during stay was easy. Not the biggest apartment and at the 5th floor with no elevators, but location is perfect, right beside Mercado de San Miguel. Highly recommended.
We had a blast in Madrid, the apartment was exactly like the description . But most important, the location was excellent . Gracias Rut y Oscar...

Great place at great location, very central close to metro. Rut was very attentive and available. Be prepared if you have luggage as it's in the 5th floor with no elevator. Thank you Rut for your hospitality!
Apartment is in a superb location, can’t be bettered. It is quite small however, much smaller than the photos suggest. There were 4 of us and it was very tight, would maybe come back as a couple.

Me and 2 of my sisters went for holiday in Madrid for 3 days. Rut greeted us when we arrived. She is a warm and friendly person. The apartment is same as advertised. Location was perfect.. the best place to stay if you want to see Madrid tourist attractions. We really enjoyed staying there.

Things were great! Love the apartment, the layout worked well for the 3 of us who wanted to catch up and comfortable sharing a studio loft. The neighborhood was edgy and interesting, great restaurants, art galleries and an international flare.
The neighborhood was seedy. Good location for metro. Host was there once. He did not fix shower problem and denied there was one.

Meeting Rodrigo's mother was great, she helped us understand the neighbourhood we were in and really gave us a great description or what to expect while we were in Madrid. The flat was as advertised, everything was well appointed and perfect for what we needed, the only drawback was understanding the hot water heater, but once we got it we were fine. The main selling point of this flat is the location and the wonderful patio, which we used for breakfast along with the kitchenette which we used for breakfast preparation. The beds were wonderful, as wonderful as being within walking distance of a metro and the Reina Sofia museum. Overall, nothing but positive things to say about Rodrigo's flat, I'd stay in another of his listings anytime.
We enjoyed our stay at Rodrigo's place. It was clean,comfortable and centrally located. We would do it again. Thanks Rodrigo.
Everthing was good. The Appartment is good located. We just spent one Night at Rodrigo's Place. Thank you!

This apartment was exactly as described and only a short 10-20 mins walk to almost all of the major central attractions of Madrid. The room and beds were comfortable with lots of extra space for 2-4 people. We enjoyed it!

The location was in a vibrant, diverse area, and it was easy to walk to beautiful sites in the city. Rodrigo was friendly and professional and gave great tips for our stay. The apartment is modern, well air-conditioned, and comfortable. I recommend staying here!
Nice place. Has everything you need. Shower great. Hot water. Although parking is awful in the area. Very hard to find a space and when you do it’s very expensive. We spent the most money on parking.

We had an excellent stay at Rodrigo’s place. It’s in a great location a short walk from the city center with easy access to the metro. It is such a cute place and spacious for the city. There are many plugs in convenient places. The kitchen was great but, do note that there aren’t any sharp knives in the kitchen. Rodrigo gave quick responses and helped us with options for navigating from the airport. Very good experience.
A lovely, stylish space. If you’re traveling in a group, I would definitely recommend this loft for your stay in Madrid.
We loved staying at Rodrigos, great central location in Madrid. Best place we stayed in our 10 days between Portugal and Spain. Would return in a heartbeat. Thank you !
Great Location, close to most attractions and the Metro,the flat did what we needed ie a place to put our heads down. had everything we needed. no problems checking in or out .

Our host was absolutely incredible- so accommodating for my particular situation, and so easy to communicate with! Location was perfect. Highly recommend and would definitely like to stay here again next time!!!

Great apartment for the price. Had a great stay in Madrid. This studio is super clean, has a nice kitchenette, and close to some of the best neighborhoods in Madrid. Carlos was very helpful and the lines of communication were always open. Thanks!

Even though I was worried because I didn't manage to stamp out and to fill in the forms with our information the whole procedure was easy and quickly, thanks to Victoria who waited our arrival in her office in the same building. There was everything needed in the flat. The place is really close to the main tourist attractions, we never took public transport in 4 days.

Carlos and Victoria's apartment is superb. It is close to the centre of Madrid as mentioned and the proximity of the metro station is simply the most convenient. The place is sparkling clean, comfortable and cosy live in. There are lots of supermarkets, restaurants of cuisines varying from Spanish to Indian to Peruvian as well. We had a wonderful time here and would love to spend our next Madrid holiday in any of their apartments. A big thanks for hosting us.

Claudia is a wonderful host! She is very welcoming, relaxed and open, and things couldn't run more smoothly. Her apartment is in a very nice area of Madrid and is situated within a few minutes walk of Diego de Leon Metro station. Recommended for a Madrid stopover!
Claudia is a great host! She is supernice! The room is comfortable and clean! The house is really well located!
A very convenient place. Very easy to find. On top of that Claudia is super friendly. Amazing hospitality- vitamin drinks, good tips on where to go. Recommendation 10/10.

The apartment is nice and it is very conveniently located close to the train station and airport bus. I was only there one night so I did not take advantage of any of Mercedes' knowledge of the city. I would recommend staying here.

The room is very nice and comfy, quiet, perfectly clean and with a great bed. It's a 5min walking distance of the Atocha train station. The Parque del Retiro is 5-10min away. Mercedes is a very nice host.
Really nice appartement close to everything by walking. The neighrood in itself is really nice too. Ricardo made us really easy to go there and our stay.

Ricardo was a great host. He stayed up late for check in as we had a late flight. Great hospitality with helping us with suggested things to do in the city, help with trains and generally very caring.

Ricardo is great host - it was a pleasure to be his guest! His kindness and help as well as the beautiful and spotless apartment made our visit in Madrid awesome! my next time in Madrid will be in Ricardo's home and I will recommend him to my friends. Ania

It was a pleasure to stay in Ricardos flat! Everything was very clean and the flat in general and the neighborhood La Latina are so nice! Ricardo gives us a lot of advices where to go in Madrid! Thank you Ricardo!

Ricardo is a fantastic host, and made us feel at home from the get-go. His recommendations for food and sightseeing are thoughtful and tasteful, allowing you to see Madrid from a local’s perspective. Stay for El Rastro, because you’ll wake up to the sight of the market happening right outside.

Ricardo is the best host that I’ve encounter. His home is super clean and nicely decorated. And it is located in the centre of the city. Thanks for being our host and it gives us a good memory. Highly recommended!
If you looking for places to stay in Madrid, Ricardo’s place is the best. Especially He has Air conditioner. “Cheaper than hotel, Better than Hotel”
We recommend! The place has incredibly good location, it was clean. Ricardo is very friendly and carreful, helped us a lot
Ricardo is an amazing host. He takes care of the guests with great interest. Also, the condition of the room is perfect and is decorated wonderfully. Thanks to Ricardo, i could have a great holiday.

Our stay in Madrid was great. The apartment was in a great location. Frank was there to greet us, he was very helpful. It's perfect for two people. The wifi wasn't very strong in the apartment and the laundry is in a separate unit. But you have your own key. Frank let us leave our bags in the office after we checked out because we had a late bus, it helped us out a lot. Would highly recommend and would stay again.

It was really nice location, its walking distance to some highlight spot in Madrid, but the area is quiet, so we can sleep very well. The unit is really nice, clean, simple, and completed. Thanks to Carlos who really punctual to wait for us at midnight in winter time!
We haven’t stay in this place, we cancel a soon as we get there because insecurity and bad location.
Patricia was super welcoming and helpful. She accommodated our time schedule both for check in and for check out. Very spacious apartment, with all sorts of amenities. Fantastic location, too!

Great stay at Patrícia's house, it's everything brand new and there's plenty of space. Its location is really central, in a very pleasing area. I'll surely come back and recomend it to everyone! Muchas gracias, Patrícia!

Thanks a lot to Jose and Patricia for being lovely hosts... place was clean and comfortable... Well-equipped kitchen, location was very convenient to good bars, restaurants and public transport..Jose was so friendly and hospitable..Would absolutely recommend this place..
Everything was great, great location and the apartment was very clean and has everything you need. The hosts were great to.

We had a very plesant stay at Domingo's appartment and he was very helpful with findings good value restaurants. I would reccomend this place to goups up to 6 persons because there are two rooms with doublebeds.

Very nice host, he waited for us at the arrival, and was very welcoming. And we were free to choose the check-out time and leave during the afternoon.The appartment is really great, clean and ideally situated. Really easy to live in! See you soon Madrid. Gracias Domingo.

We loved our stay in Madrid. The apartment is gorgeous and the hosts were fantastic. They went out of their way to help us. The apartment is in a great location and is so homely. Our favourite accommodation in Spain.

The house was as the photos show. Very cozy, clean and nicely equipped. The owner was just the best there is and very kind in all aspects. She even put some fresh flowers for us. The house is surrounded by shops that can be used to buy groceries and stuff for the house. I highly recommend the house and would come back if I had to.

Domingo's apartment was beautiful and had plenty of room for all 6 of us. We were so happy looking out the huge front windows to the streets. The location was perfect and we were able to walk everywhere. There are thousands of amazing places to eat, but the host's recommendations were our favorites. Everything was clean and comfortable. If you visit Madrid this is the best place to stay!

Lovely apartment with a homely feel about it. Perfect for a city break or longer. Comfortable and clean and set centrally so easy to get to The Metro and to local tourist areas and restaurants The only downside is that there are 70 stairs up to the apartment and no lift so may not be great for the elderly or anyone with mobility issues The hosts are very welcoming. Would highly recommend this property.

The location of the apartments, the conveniences in them, the opportunity to live in the past thanks to the things that are present in them, Domingo and his wife, who are always ready to help, maked our stay in Madrid unforgettable
During our stay we felt like we are at home. Domingo and Carmen are very nice and kind persons) The apartment is clear and cozy. Our stay was great!

Gorete's apartment was incredible. It has a great location, and is near all the touristic and historical spots. The street is full of supermarkets, restaurants, and is very close to metro stations (about 5-minutes walk), including the famous Puerta del Sol. The apartment is as stylisih as in the pictures, spotless clean, with everything you need to cook, rest, bathe, everything. The building has roomy elevators for easy access especially with luggage. We had an amazing time and Gorete and Alicia are very kind and attentive to details and beyond. We hope we can come back and stay again here!
Nice accommodations in great location! Everything reachable by foot. Miguel is a great and helpful host and I would recommend the place!

Macarena’s place is lovely, quiet and cosy - so I got a great nights sleep in busy Madrid. It's walking distance to centre (30 mins) or 10 minutes by subway to centre. Had great inspiring conversations with Macarena during complimentary breakfast as we both, coincidentally, work in the same fields! - theatre!
Breakfast is served, all areas of the house is neat and clean, very welcoming atmosphere in the house.
This was my second time staying at Macarena’s on this trip so I could catch an early fight. Just as welcoming and hospitable as the time before. It’s a great spot for single travelers.
Macarena was very accommodating and I enjoyed my stay with her. Close to bus/metro. Macarena provided many suggestions for my brief stay in Madrid. Very friendly and helpful.

My boyfriend and I loved this apartment! The location was perfect-- in a bustling neighborhood not far from the Gran Via. There were excellent restaurants nearby, and we were able to walk to the Prado. The apartment seemed new and was extremely clean and well equipped. The shower was great. Renan was very sweet and responsive, though he did not speak much English. I would highly recommend staying here, and will return if I visit Madrid again!

very good appartment.. clean .. brand new and super central.. i think i took the metro just two times during my stay.. yo can easly walk to all the main attactions.. Renan was super helpful and for any issue after 5 minutes there was somebody to help.. and Renan is super cute! :) raccomended!
Beautiful apartment, exactly as advertised. We were so close to everything! Would definitely stay again.

This flat was nice. The bed was very comfortable and the location was good as it was walking distance to a lot of things. We didn't spend much time in the flat itself though because we were out most of the day and only came back to sleep and then checked out in the morning. Melvin y Mario were really sweet - they held on to our bags after check out because as we waited for our train that night. A couple chocolates and bottle of wine upon arrival, too. Muchas Gracias, George

The location was great it's right in downtown everything is supper close. Melvin and Carolina were great people. Carolina met me right as I arrived and walked me into the room and even gave me some pointers on places to visit. They left us a bottle of wine on the house. The pictures are exactly what it looks like. It's a cozy place everything you need is there. I would consider staying there again.

The flat was exactly as described on the listing, in a central location just off Gran Via. The apartment is close to many of the popular tourist areas of Madrid so we did not need to use the metro other than to get to/from the airport. Melvin was a good host, leaving a bottle of wine on the table for when we arrived.

Great location and great communication from the host! Easy to get keys! However thin walls so can hear the neighbors and not hot water in the shower some mornings/evening (must be connected to the other apartments). Overall great apartment with everything you need and reasonably priced! Would recommend.

Our check in was a breeze. I did not meet Melvin because of the time of our arrival was very late, but we have been communicating prior to our arrival. I did meet his colleague who was also very pleasant, helpful and gifted us with wine. The apartment is exactly where you need to be. In the center of it all. Melvin is a great host! Thank you for everything.

The good and the bad. The good: excellent customer service. Melvin and his team were fantastic, attentive, easily accessible. Location is in one of Madrid's best areas. The bad. You cannot flush toilet paper down the toilet. The toilet is electric. We were not notified of this prior to booking. It would have changed our minds. Also, the photos are a bit misleading. They don't represent the true disrepair of the place. Bottom line: good place for solo traveler. Bed small for two people, bad toilet, but great customer service in a great neighborhood with great bars and restaurants. If you are someone who normally stays in hostels and pensiones in Madrid, this is a step up. After traveling Spain for almost 20 years, this was a bit disappointing.

The location was amazing, very central to everything. Overall the place was very clean and looked like the photos, however, the bathroom did not work properly (shower/toilet). The wifi barely worked, and the locks are super old so it was very hard to get in the front door of the building. Melvin himself was great- very reliable and friendly and super quick to respond to messages. Was comfortable for a one night stay, but longer would not have suited our needs/comfort level.
This is a great location and easy to find! The apartment is super and spacious! A home away from home!
Great stay here, apartment exactly as pictures show beautiful and the location is AMAZZZING!! Guillermo was very helpful, would definitely recommend a stay here :)
Great place, great location, welcoming and flexible. Very nice place to stay in and the AC worked very well.

Andre is a kind, caring and helpful host. The room is just as presented (photos, descriptions, location). Very conveniently located near the metro which connects both Chamartin and Atocha train stations.

We had a great time at Andre's place. His apartment was very tidy and equipped with everything you need. Andre was very helpful and efficient since the beginning. Would totally recommend to stay here.

Great experience, the location is superb, you are right in the center of the city with easy access to everything. The flat is beautiful, with very nice details and the hosts were super nice and helpful. I would recommend and I would stay there again.

The apartment was very clean and lovely! Since the apartment is perfectly located it was a bit noisy during the Night. Even though we would definitely rebook the apartment when travelling to Madrid again! Superfast communication.

Well decorated apartment with in the heart of the city, perfect location to get around the city by subway (Sol stop). The apartment is on a busy shopping street, but it's very quiet indoors when the windows are closed. Aircon is nice 2 units, one in the living and one in the bedroom. Kitchen is pretty much fully stocked with equipment, but no herbs or oil (nobody lives in the apartment, its only used for Airbnb) its not a practical kitchen (sink is in a corner next to the fridge) but good enough to cook a simple meal. I would definitely recommend it to anyone travelling as a couple or solo, and will go back next time I visit!

Dani met us exactly on time and was very charming. The apartment was immaculate, beautifully furnished and very comfortable. It was equipped with everything that we needed. It was our first time in Madrid and we were delighted with the location. We walked everywhere and often popped back to the apartment during the day as it often seemed to be on route to our next stop.

What a wonderful find. The apartment was perfect and the location couldn't be better. You're in the heart of it all. Felt very safe in the area and in the apartment. The host Marga is a great person and very welcoming. You won't go wrong booking this location. Thanks Marga for a great stay. Paul and Ketty
Nice place, shower handle was very loose and fell right off for first use, plastic shower curtain. Location on busy walking only street, sometimes loud on weekends
Apartment was fine for a short stay but there are visible signs of wear. Shower in the upstairs bathroom was broken so it made it difficult to use. Location was a bit far from central Madrid.

A great loft in the centre of Madrid- we'd definitely stay here again! Minty host was very responsive leading up to our arrival. They provided us with a guidebook and met up at the address with the keys as soon as we arrived from the airport. It was exactly as shown in the pictures and was perfect for us. Thanks Verónica and Minty host- we had a wonderful stay!

The place was exactly as pictured. It was quiet and also very central. The apartment is smartly designed and the hosts were very communicative. We only stayed two nights but if we wanted to stay longer we had everything we needed in the apartment. I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to have a great Madrid experience.

Location!Location!Location!this apartment has a unique and competitive location which is only 30 seconds to plaza Mayor and St.Miguel Market.Prado museum in 10min away.it's very convenient to take metro from Opera or Sol station(walk in 2-3min)to every places of attractions.of course there are many good restaurants around apartment.Veronica helped me a lot before I arrived,her gave me accurate information about everything I need in Madrid. Her lovely apartment is the same as described on airbnb,well equipped, clean,and quiet in the evening(although it is in the very center of Madrid,many bars around)if u want to have a good sleep.there is a balcony with street view beside Plaza Mayor.by the way,Minty host is in charge of managing Veronica's apartment,the girl Claudia is very nice and prepared everything well for us.all in all, my husband and I has unforgettable experience of Madrid in this lovely apartment(loft).

Central location and great host. The surround sound speaker system is a nice touch and the shower is terrific. One minor warning, as others have mentioned, the bed is up a narrow flight of stairs and the bedroom ceiling is quite low. It was no issue for us, but I can see how it could be for some.

The location is absolute awesome. It is easy to access to many interesting points by walking. Our main complaint is that after checking in we no longer got response from the host for any of our requests.
Jose's apartment is cozy and clean with easy access to the heart of Madrid. His hospitality made us feel welcome and confortable. I highly recommend this stay!
Great place to have a short stay. Jose is an extremely kind person, and very quick to solve any problem for you as well.

Great place to stay visiting Madrid. Just in the middle of everything. The apartment has been remodeled so everything is brand new. Well equipped. It is a 3th floor with no elevator and no views, that is thee only thing you have to worry about, otherwise it is a gem.
A very nice apartment . The host was very helpful and polite. Great location. Everything we needed in the apartment . We had a lovely time in Madrid! Thanks!

Highly recommended!. The place is amazing, sparkly clean, and with the best location to stay in Madrid!. The customer service is unbeatable, they treated us like family, we felt very welcome. We keep communication with the host. Our flight was cancelled and they were very understanding about to do a different time check in. Best host ever!.

The apartment is very central, trendy and modern inside, however, has a decor of a uniquely old Spanish building. It is extremely central and is a shopping haven. The departmental stores are close by, eating joints, and public transport is very closeby. It is a very posh locality and is very safe. Fernando has been a perfect host, waiting for us and helping us even though we reached quite late at night. He was always there to help us on any query and help. I strongly recommend this place with a very hospitable host for all to stay. I would like to stay again, in case I get an opportunity to visit Madrid. The stay in the apartment made my stay in Madrid an extra fillip....thank you, Fernando!

Had a fantastic weekend in Madrid. The apartment was beautiful, clean, comfortable and so well located. Our check in was seamless and we were given a handy self-written guide to Madrid by Cristina which enabled us to plan an awesome stay. I would definitely stay here again. Can't rate it highly enough. 🙂

Gracias Cristina! We had a great time! Location was perfect! Pictures did the place justice, clean, comfortable and great location! Recomend this place for sure!! Also, Agustin, who met us to check in, was friendly, provided us with a map and gave us some direcctions. He was very friendly and helpful! Really enjoyed our stay in Madrid!! Sylvia & Julio

Cris’s flat in La Latina was a great place to stay in Madrid. The location was unbeatable: very close to many great places to eat and within walking distance of a lot of the tourist attractions. We loved the guide that Cris sent with things to do, see, and eat in the city. The apartment itself was very nice and had all of the amenities that we needed. The AC was a plus and the apartment was more spacious than we expected. We highly recommend staying here!

Beautiful flat in great location. The flat was clean and the air con was appreciated! Cris really easy to get hold of to answer any questions. Would definitely stay here again if back in Madrid. Thanks Cris :)

Arzu's apartment is well appointed, has fast internet (not always the case in short-term rentals) clean and really convenient to Madrid. While you are mere steps from the San Miguel Market, Plaza Mayor, Royal Palace, Opera, countless restaurants and the Metro (and more), the street this apartment is on is quiet and primarily foot traffic. And beyond the apartment, Arzu is a gracious host who checked up on us during our stay and was very forthcoming with recommendations and all the information that we needed for a great stay. We highly recommend this apartment!

Gorgeous apartment in a great location! Just a short walk from Palacia Real, Mercado de San Miguel, Plaza Mayor, and Puerto del Sol. Apartment was clean and bright, and it was great bonus to be able to do laundry in the apt.
Antonio was great! He met us right as we arrived from the airport. The space is very clean and cute. We had a great time here
Great and clean location that has just what you need for a traveling couple. Right between the Palace and the Retiro park.

Great experience. High quality flat, building and appliances, the flat doesn’t feel “cheap”. Well insulated refurbished flat, zero noise from the neighbours in the building. Professional management by Maria. Would return.

Apartment was clean and furnished nicely. The location was very convenient. It was walking distance to Prado museum, main train station, other sight seeing and shopping areas. It was near the Anton Martin metro station.
The location was perfect, it was close to everything. The apartment was clean and quiet. The communication was good.

We spent 6 nights in Maria's apartment. The location is fantastic, very central and we felt very safe as Maria lives and works next door. The apartment was clean and cosy and Maria is a warm and generous host. We would definately stay here again when we return to Madrid!

An amazing apartment in the centre of Madrid with everything you could want a few steps away. The apartment is lovely, spacious and very clean. Madrid is a super place and this apartment is the ideal base to explore it.
Great host! The apartment was perfect for our family of 5, very clean and in a great location!

This apartment has a unique location, the facilities are comfortable and very clean, the hosts are attentive to any questions and explain you exactly how to get in . Is the best option to stay in Madrid.
It was very nice to communicate with Melvin. Location of the apartment is perfect I would definitely recommend it.

Mariola’s place is perfect! It is gorgeous and in a very central location. We walked everywhere from it. Very clean and Maroila is a great host. She was available if we needed her, very hospitable and helpful and gave us some great tips on where to eat.
Cozy and small flat with a partial view of an alley. close to restaurants and metro. Small shower, but decent water pressure. Mariola was very helpful and responsive

Beautifully stylish apartment in an excellent location, only metres from Bilbao metro station and minutes from the heart of Chueca. Although it's in a lively area, the apartment was quiet. Mariola was the perfect host with prompt communication and easy check in. Recommended.
Stylish apartment with easy access to the metro,Mariola was quick to respond to our query.
This was such a lovely stay in a great neighbourhood. Communication with Mariola was easy and welcoming. I will definitely be back to Madrid and look up this apt for a stay again. Thank you!

The apartment was nice, cozy and clean. The location was convenient. We walked to most major attractions but the Metro station is very close too. Mariola was always quick to respond and provided some great tips. We had an excellent stay in Madrid and would definitely recommend Mariola’s place.
Ana's apartment is in a small suburb outside the city centre. It was clean and comfortable and well equipped with extras which was nice. Thank you Ana!
Ana's apartment was very clean. The kitchen was well stocked and there were toys for kids The air conditioning was very much appreciated in the middle of August!

The apartment was ideally situated in the centre of Madrid: close to the metro, supermarket and Plaza Mayor/Puerta del Sol. We did a lot by foot. Quick communication. We had a wonderful stay in Madrid!
Brilliant location and communication. can be a bit noisy during the twilight hours but I think that's because it's so central.

I didn't get to meet them but he was really great about meeting my friend to drop off the keys for me before my arrival. Description of the place is very good and everything was impeccable. Neighborhood is fine. Anton martin area is sketch sometimes at night but fine over all. Great location bc it's central. Amor de Dios Flamenco studios around the corner as well as Central De Cine.

The apartment was clean, bright and well-located. It has air conditioning, which is almost essential in the summer. It is in a good position, close to the metro and a main train station, the main museums and park. The apartment is on the top floor but there is lift access. I would stay here again.

The studio is in a great location, about a 10 minute walk to the Museo del Prado and 15-20 min. from the Buen Retiro Park (one of our favorite spots in the city). We took the metro from the airport (45 minutes) and then walked the short distance to the place. Alejo was great, he even met us at a local restaurant to give us the key. The place was comfortable and clean. The shades on the windows and the sky lights made jet-lag more tolerable. The building and the neighborhood feel safe, and there are plenty of restaurants in walking distance. We walked to most things in the city from the studio.

This was a beautiful studio. The bed was incredibly comfortable. Exactly how the pictures show. Alejo was very helpful and made sure to have his friend there, even though I arrived late in the evening. I would recommend this to anyone or couples.

Overall our stay in Madrid was lovely. There was a bit of an issue in accessing the apartment. I emailed Alejo a day and a half before arrival asking about how to get the key but didn't hear back. Long story short we went the apartment and rang the buzzer but there was no answer so Airbnb got in touch with him while we waited in a cafe down the street with wifi, this was dissappointing after a long travel day. Besides that our stay was great. The apartment is huge in comparison to other places we stayed in Europe and Alejo was so nice to leave fruit, bread, juice for us. He also gave great recommendations on what sites to see in Madrid during our short stay. The apartment is very clean and the bed is super comfy too. Location was a short walk to everything we wanted to do and a couple nice cafe and bars right not the street.
Efficient host who helped us access the apt which was great in a timely manner. Nice space in a terrific location.

Alejo was a great host. He let us do the checking prior 12:00 which was very helpful when you are loaded with bags. He also kept the bags for us in a safe room until 2:00, which allowed us to do things until catching the train. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. Location was exellent. The only two things I think I should mention was that washing machine was not working and the drain in the tub did not drain properly. Overall our experience was great and I would recommend this place for a couple who wants to spend sometime in an authentic neighborhood of Madrid.

Great place and location. It looked like they may have forgotten to clean the shower after the last guest, but other than that, the place was spotless and hosts were really responsive. Elevator was also really convenient to get our suitcases up to the 4th floor.

Very clean, compact apartment. Great location for visiting Madrid. Centrally located on a quiet street. Within a few minutes walking distance of many attractions including Sol, Plaza Mayor, Reina Sofia and Prado museums. Very good communication from the host.

We had a great time at Alfonso’s place. It is really good located - near to all the fantastic tapas bars, main tourist places and metro station. The communication and check-in were easy. The air conditioner worked perfectly and the apartment is well equipped. We can highly recommend to stay at this location!

We really enjoyed staying with Carmen. She is a kind, friendly and helpful person. The house is located in quiet and safe neighbourhood and is easy to reach by bus. The neighbourhood has a few cafes, a market, small shops and a supermarket. I can recommend this place and would be happy to come back.

This is an amazing place, clean, centrally located, and walking distance to a 24HR supermarket. I did not meet naza directly but communication was perfect. She is a really good host and will do anything to accommodate you during your stay. I really recommend this place.
We found a clean apartment with some soft drinks waiting for us. We really liked the neighbourhood, lots of bars :)

The apartment is very clean and comfortable. Space is enough for 4 people to fit. Apartment is convenient to shopping and restaurants. Close to Gran Via, Del Sol and other main attractions. Easy access to the metro system.

This apartment is located bang right in the centre of the city and all the locations that are must visits in Madrid are closeby. You get all the amenities that are needed to make your stay super convenient. If you're planning to have hassle free stay in Madrid, book off this place before it runs out
The house has perfect location and fully-equiped facility. The host is very generous and leave a bottle of wine as a gift for check in. Thank you again.

Amazing location in a really cool neighborhood and near everything else! The apt is nice, clean and equipped with everything from towels and soap to wine. Only minus was the toilet that doesn't flush verywell and very thin walls...
Great location. Air conditioning was a godsend with temperatures over 100F. The washing machine was nice to have as well. Would stay here again when in Madrid.
Everything was perfect. The location is great very close to a lot of restaurants and Plaza Mayor. Definitely would stay there again.

Lauren’s place is lovely, bright and airy, and central to most touristy locations in Madrid. Lauren was easy to communicate with and a really kind and cheery host. She was also kind enough to let us check in early, which we really appreciated. The apartment is equipped with everything you could possibly need, nicely decorated, and roomy with plenty of space for 3 people. We really enjoyed our stay and would stay again next visit to Spain. Thanks Lauren!

Pros: Laren is a great host and was responsive. The kitchen was well stocked and had extras like tea, coffee, and wine. The towels were nice and soft and the apartment had a good amount of space. The apartment was also clean. Cons: While you cannot hear noise from the busy street below, it is possible to hear quite a bit of noise coming from neighbors opening and closing doors and running water.
Place was clean and just like the pictures. Location was great and would stay again! Thank you!!
The place is comfy and has a tons of different appliances, and even a dishwasher! It could use some more attention to detail though: some utensils were not washed well, for example
Everything, from cleanliness to comfort, was brilliant! Definitely recommend for any young couple visiting, who is looking for a cost effective, cosy place!

The apartment was great. It's a good size, especially for where it is. The kitchen and bathroom were also very nice. The location is amazing! The pictures in the listing don't do it justice. We were there for three days and never took a taxi or metro. You can walk everywhere. The downside to the location is it can be noisy at night. You're on the second floor just outside Plaza Mayor. Bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper, but it's to be expected in that location. The host is very friendly and made arriving and leaving very easy.
Soraya greeted us at her apartment which was just as advertised on the web site. Soraya gave us plenty of local information and also provided a detailed list of places to eat this was most helpful.

Soraya was unable to greet us however she made sure we got everything that we needed prioir to our arrival. We met with another who was most hospitable. The place was perfect, clean and right in the centre of everything. Very happy with our choice and highly recommended for your stay in Madrid.

Soraya was a wonderful host, very accessible, warm and responsive to our needs. She put together a local guide with restaurant and activity suggestions that was totally right on! The apartment was just as advertised, clean, bright with lots of windows and balconies. The location is right at the the Plaza Mayor, you even have a view of one of the entrances to the plaza. It is an exciting and busy location, within walking distance of most of the sights, including the Prado, Parque de Retiro, Reyna Sofia Museum, Plaza del Sol and much more. Would definitely recommend a stay!
Excellent experience. The apartment is modern, very well thought out and the location is perfect.

Nice place at the heart of Madrid really :) We like the decoration even we will copy the bar part to our kitchen :) Clean apartment and thanks to Soraya that when we reach there she was near to us :) Soraya's business is close to the apartment even if we did not need to ask something to her, it is nice to know that she is close :)

The location is perfect if you want to be downtown. The studio is nice with a beautiful view. We had a water leak issue while there and the hosts were able to fix it in a timely manner. Definitely recommend for any Madrid vacation!

Soraya was very friendly and welcoming . She met us promptly when we arrived at the apartment and gave us a thorough intro to the apartment. She was readily available afterwards for any questions we might have.
The apartment is in a great location but was very noisy. It is well equipped and clean.

A beautiful apartment steps from the Plaza Mayor. Pictures and description are very accurate. Three small balconies with room for two small chairs each. Great for people watching and wine sipping. Highly recommended.
Soraya's place is only feet away from Mayor Plaza and it's surrounded by restaurants and shops. Highly recommended.

Soraya’s apartment was clean and stylish, located very central! We loved being in the city Center so close to everything. The radiator can be a little noisy at night, just a word of caution. Overall we had a great few days!
This place feels like the center of Madrid. it's very lively at all times. You could keep the windows open an take it all in. Or simply close them and turn on the AC for a quite sleep.

Cant get a better location in Madrid. You can see, here and feel the wonderful spanish vibe from the Plaza Mayor. The apartment exceeded all our expectations. Soroya and her husband were so friendly and welcoming. It was such a great start to our Spanish Holiday. Hope to come back again one day.

Cannot beat the convenience of a central location. Plaza Mayor is visible from the the balcony and observing the throngs of tourists flowing by provides endless entertainment. The apartment is modern and provided enough space for my wife and I. The Sol metro station is a short walk from the apartment and numerous dining and shopping options are nearby. The hosts were fantastic and interested in making sure our stay was enjoyable. The hosts own a cafe a few meters from the apartment that offers great breakfast selections and coffee. We had a wonderful stay in Madrid and highly recommend the property.
Angel is a really good host. The flat is located just 1 min from the metro station, is fully equipped and very clean. I truly recommend it! :-)

Angel was an amazing host, great local tips, the place was perfect, with great amenities and super clean. I would strongly recommend him. He went above and beyond to make my friend and I feel comfortable.
Such a beautiful space. The flat is gorgeous, has everything you need and the location is fab. Great communication and host super helpful. Would stay again.
Great apartment in a great part of the city. Had a great time. Wouls stay there again.
I liked the Balcony.The place is located in a very quiet area. The owner is very welcoming.
We had a wonderful stay!! Great location, clean place, fast wifi, and we were able to do laundry - everything went perfect!

We had a great 10 days in this apartment. The location is incredible (near to shops and restaurants) and communication beforehand with Javier was great. The space is really cute and clean, we did find that we had to sleep in separate locations as the bed is quite narrow (we are reasonably tall). However the sofa bed is exceptionally comfortable. Definitely would stay here again.
We were made to feel really welcome. The photos were accurate and a perfect flat for 2 couples. 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.

The flat is beautifully presented and very conveniently located. Lola was very attentive replying to questions promptly. It is in an old building although the flat itself recently decorated. Thus, the noises can be heard from next room or even upstairs.
Very nice house. The house was new and clean. Nice hosting. If you prefer a calm place than a noise(downtown), i really recommend you here. Near from sol. Very good to take bus,metro or taxi.
Amazing! Jorge it's such a great host. He gave us thousands of suggestions before we even asked for it. The place is stylish as it is in the pictures, and the location is perfect.

The studio was really clean and modern. Had air conditioning,which was a huge plus as it was so warm. We were accommodated with an early checkin which was great. The lady who checked us in was very friendly and helpful with telling us how to get around the area 😊

We stayed in the apartment for 3 nights and we were really satisfied. Location of the flat is in the very centre and close to the nearest metro station. Nearby are also grocery shops, pharamacy, fast foods. Absolutly recommend for all the travelers into Madrid. Owner of the flat was answering almost immediately and he was flexible and helpful about our arrival. Thank you!

Accommodation was very clean and modern. Location was brilliant, all main attractions were within walking distance. Host was very quick with responses and check in was straight forward. No faults to mention.

A great space in a central location! The apartment was very comfortable for two people, right around the corner from grocery stores & bars and a short walk to Palacio Real or Sol. Very clean, a great value for the price. Would stay here again!

In the middle of everything. Such a nice experience for my first stay in Madrid!! Apartment is 2 blocks away from Puerta del Sol and 1/2 block from Gran Via. Walking distance to most attractions. I didn't meet Pablo, but he always responded to all of my needs, gently and quickly. Patricia, helped providing early check in accommodation for an extra guest. I strongly recommend this apt for either a couple or a family up to 4 people. Gracias chicos por la atencion, nos vemos pronto! Luis, Alberto & Lucas!!!

Modern clean apartment in the centre of town, 2 minutes walk from Callao. Central, busy bustling city centre right outside your door! Apartment itself is comfortable with everything you need, had a lift, safe and secure. Nice bathroom with shower. Easy to get around using Metro. We did a trip to Segovia & Àvila which I'd highly recommend, a nice day out. We used Express Tours, €40. Lots of souvenir shops offering their trips. For the best churros, visit San Ginés, 5 minute walk from apartment. Also Mercado de San Miguel for an amazing selection of tapas.

Thank you Lola for being an amazing host! We couldn’t have asked for a better and thoughtful person to stay with. Lola is very friendly and fun to talk to! She made us breakfast and offered us traditional Spanish food and drink. Lola’s apartment is very central and in walking distance to public transport, shops and restaurants. She has the cutest dog named Lolo! The room was spacious, warm and comfortable to sleep in. Great host, great apartment! I would highly recommend stay there. Gracias Lola!

My absolute favorite place to stay in Madrid! This flat is wonderful. Barrio Salamanca is a great neighborhood. Beatriz was so nice and hospitable. The flat was clean and very stylish. Will definitely stay here again.

Everything was great, the apartment is wonderful and comfortable. Great location. The hospitality was awesome, we had pastries and fruit for breakfast. The communication with the host was also super easy. Overall, we had a lovely time!

The place is excellent, just as described. It is tastefully designed and has everything you may need for a short stay. What I liked the most was the location. Just steps away from the metro and at fairly short walking distance from Madrid’s highlights. While I didn’t meet Moncho, communication was great and the check-in process was really smooth.
Simple, clean space - nice area near some great locations but tucked away on a more residential street. Our first time in Madrid was a success and we really appreciated the great hospitality!
The house was clean and comfortable. It takes only two minutes to get to the metro station and around 10 minutes to Alsa bus station. My friend specifically likes the mattress which is comfortable.
Comfortable stay. Good communication and a perfect location close to Atocha railway station, groceries, etc. Recommended.

The accommodation was excellent, it was in a great location and about 10 minutes from Retiro Park which is a must to visit. There are restaurants, cafes and shops nearby and handy for the subway. The flat is on the 2nd floor but there is a lift. It was quiet and felt safe. The accommodation was a home from home and the host provided all you need to start off your visit. We had a warm welcome from Maria and she explained how everything worked. I’ve stayed in lots of four/five hotels but this was even better. When I’m back in Madrid I will book this accommodation, it was clean and fresh looking and air conditioning in all rooms. I was staying with my wife and older daughter and we all agreed it helped make our stay in Madrid great. Deserves to be a super host.

Carlos is a great host and the apartment couldn’t be better! It was really well decorated, full of details, spectacular location and 2 comfortable bedrooms and 2 cozy bathrooms. Thanks Carlos for everything! We enjoy our stay a lot.
The place is great! The shower and the bed were comfortable. Just in front of the subway and train station! I would stay there again!
We really enjoyed Cristina’s place. Very close to the train station and Metro and a small store right next door. Would stay there again

The apartment is truly one of a kind. Super stylish, and extremely clean. The location is perfect and pretty much close to everything. We loved the energy around the location. Overall, we were very happy with our stay and we would love to stay here again if we came back to Madrid. Christina was extremely accommodating and friendly. Very quick responses. Christina was an amazing host.

Very nice house, clean and tidy. It is only a few steps from the station.Luggage can be stored in the station, which is very convenient.The location is very good and you can walk to all the attractions. The host was very kind and answered us promptly.

The room was exactly as described and as shown in the pictures. Compact, so clean, so comfortable and so conveniently located. We walked everywhere from the apartment. The high ceilings give great feeling of space. Lovely, luxurious towels. Great communications and the host kindly allowed us to store our cases after checkout time until we needed to catch the train.
Good experience with Cristina, she was really reactive. The apartment was really clean and well located, not far from the center of Madrid. Thank you, Cristina!
Everything we needed - great location near to museums and Atocha Train station. Stylishly done and sparkling clean. The air con was our saviour in Madrid Summer heat!

A modern, sleek, and stylish apartment close to the Museums in Madrid and the Atocha train station. The bed is up on a loft and very comfortable. The bathroom has unique and nice features, I loved the shower! Overall, a nice place to stay if you are in Madrid for a few days.

This loft is as beautiful and clean as it shows in picture. The building feels very safe, is surrounded by convenient and friendly little shops and is very close to Museo de Reina Sofía and Parque del Retiro. The actual living space inside is much smaller than expected. There’s practically no space to be shared, so I recommend it for one guest, and one who has no issues climbing up steep stairs to go to bed, and one who is not bothered by light filtering through windows at night. All in all, very charming.
A beautiful and comfortable home and a location very close to Retiro! We had a wonderful time at Christina's!
There is not much to say, since the apartment is simply amazing. It is really small, but beautifully furnished and perfect for a couple!!! I can only recommend it.
We had an amazing time. The apartment was clean and homely. Good walking distance to the city.
Great place right in the heart of Lalatina. Very Modern, everything was as described, the A/C was outstanding and it was very clean. Highly Recommend!
Absolutely charming place in a wonderful neighborhood. Don't be scared off by the attic--there's an elevator!

Eduardo’s apartment is fabulous, looks just like the photos and has everything you could ask for. The location is very central and almost all of Madrid’s main attractions are in walking distance, there’s a metro station very close to the apartment as well. Me and my mother really enjoyed our stay here and would definitely like to come again. Thank you Eduardo and Gladice for being so kind and thoughtful!

The apartment is very good situated, nice area with a lots of possibilities. To the retiro park only 800 meters. All the interior is very good quality, well decorated with a lot of taste. Everything in the apartment was in best shape, and Gabriel is almost always available if there is a question. Floor heating, which is not very common in Madrid (as I think). AC has the right size, everything nice!

Marta is a very nice host, she waited us in the apartment and gave us detailed instructions on facility usage and even advice of sightseeing. The apartment is just looks like the pic on bnb, all the facilities are new and clean. It's really a cozy place. There are 2 metro lines nearby and easy to connect with all the main places. And, walk is also possible as it is in the center and walking itself is the Best way to know the city. The is a supermarket, carrefour, within about 200 meters and lots of restaurant around the building, suitable for travelling with family and friends. Highly recommend!
Very nice apartment and very clean. 10-15 min walking distance to all major attractions, very good location. Host communication was very quick, within minutes. Overall very happy with our stay.

As a host, David was quick to respond with any questions or concerns. Check-in was very easy as well. The apartment is fantastic and well maintained. He was also kind enough to include a hand-drawn map of the neighborhood. Highly recommend this airbnb. Thanks again David.

David place is very spacious, clean and welcoming. I had a great stay from the easy checking (face to face ), tips and guide about the surroundings blocks and fast response. The apartment is located in a quite street but just a few minutes walk from bars, cafes and shopping area. Thanks again !

The location of the apartment was excellent ! In a pleasant neighborhood, near the center, and across the most lovely bar (excellent for breakfast in the morning !). We felt that we could not have stayed at a better place !! The apartment has very recently been renovated and has all the comfort ! Even though we arrived past midnight, we were welcomed and shown into the apartment. We had a magnificent long weekend at Madrid and this apartment and it's location did contribute to that !!

I can not recommend this flat highly enough. The owners are thoughtful, helpful and warm. Ana went out of her way to respond to all my restaurant and transportation questions. The flat itself is so clean, stylish and well appointed with everything a family needs to be comfortable and happy. It is a stone’s throw from Plaza Mayor and loads of great restaurants and cafes. Perfecto!

We absolutely loved staying at Ana's place. The location was perfect -- very central and in a safe and charming neighborhood. The apartment was beautiful and well decorated. And the beds are incredibly comfortable! The kitchen and bathrooms were well stocked with all the amenities you could need. But the best part of all was the thoughtfulness of our wonderful host, Ana. Our flight was delayed by three hours and we arrived at the apartment after 1:00 a.m. Not only did Ana meet us at the apartment, she brought food and drinks for our hungry family of four. It was just what we needed after a long day. Ana clearly cares about her guests and it was what made our trip to Madrid very special. I HIGHLY recommend Ana's place!

Maria Luis was a very good host. The apartment really nice , clean, quiet and the top in the cherry is that is very close to everything. Even though you are at the downtown area and Chueca , the apartment is really quiet.

Clara and Amir were great hosts. I arrived a little late on check in date and Clara waited for me with the keys and didn’t charge extra. We had one small issue with the bathroom and she was very quick to fix it. The space is beautiful and clean, just like the photos. Will definitely stay again if in Madrid.

Amir’s apartment is an excellent choice for a place to stay while visiting Madrid. The apartment is super cute, very clean, and it’s in a great location. Both Amir and Clara were super responsive and went out of their way to help us accommodate parking our rental car. We very much appreciated their hospitality during our stay.

The flat is tiny, but it's wonderful place to stay for a few days. Interior is nice, apartment is clean and equipped with everything you should need. Sometimes you could hear neighbors, but It's not a big problem. location is wery convenient, but nearby streets are dirty. Iwona was wery helpful. In total we get more, then we were waiting.

Iwona is a great host. Very quick in responding and also helpful with any occurring problems. The flat itself is small but perfect for visiting Madrid a couple of days. I can definitely recommend this place...
anto is a kindness and available guy .really good quality price and the 2 garages are very convenients best regards
Location was great as I expected, the studio was clean, also the Nelson who was contacted me was very friendly and let me to leave my suitcase before check in time, I recommend this place

Incredibly quiet! Even though the appartement is in the middle of bustling Chueca, if the neighbours are out there is almost absolute silence, even on a Saturday night with people all around the street. I hope to go here again when I visit Madrid again. Everything else was fine too, but location plus quietness is the big selling point.
The apartment is very central for tourists. It is easy walking distance to Gran Via, hop on hop off bus and attractions

It was a very good staying! Location is great - right in the heart of the so called "la vida mandrillena" The host was very flexible and solved our questions at once! Marvelous balcony and lots of space to every of our 11 person group I would recommend it defiantly

This apartment was a fantastic place to stay. It is close to a lot of activities and it was impeccably clean and fresh looking. Esther was very helpful and communication was superb. You can’t go wrong by staying here! 👍👍
This rental was in a truly excellent central location. It was everything that we hoped for and needed for our vacation in Spain.
Beautiful area. Nice apartment. Very Clean. Suggestions for the area and local information would have been helpful.
The flat was absolutely beautiful, in an amazing location and Marcelo was an incredible host. Would highly recommend to other guests and would love to stay here again.

We thought the location was great and the flat has a great size for a weekend! Maria's mum welcomed us and was super friendly and even showed us around in the neighborhood to find restaurants and supermarkets. Check in was flexible and we were even able to leave our luggage all day in the apartment, because there weren't any guests coming after us! The beds (1 coach, 1 bed) weren't too comfortable sadly - it was fine for a weekend though! Thanks for having us and we definitely recommend the apartment!

We are upset to say that our check-out experience was extremely discerning. We were told by Luz, the host, that check out was at 12 pm (also listed on Airbnb) and two individuals let themselves into the apartment at 10:30 am without knocking. We were both naked and unprepared to leave as we were under the impression we had until 12 pm. Nonetheless we quickly packed our things and were pushed out at 11 am. This not only was invalid information and expectations but an invasion of our privacy. Other than that the toilet seat was broken and felt the apartment was unequipped for a guest stay (laundry and cooking essentials). We will not be back nor can we recommend this place to future guests.

Great value and location! The apartment is compact but the price reflects that. Overall a great stay! The double bed was super comfy and the apartment is a one minute walk from the 6 Circular metro and a major bus stop. There is also a grocery store and giant, beautiful park less than a 5 minute walk away. Would stay again!

The apartment is beautifully styled and clean! Has everything that you need and is located central to everything so can walk everywhere or if you need, it is right near the metro station. Leeway’s were great with communicating and made our stay very enjoyable, couldn’t recommend this apartment any more!
Very clean and fairly good value. Check in process was slightly impersonal since it was a « self check-in » process. That aside, we had a great stay and would come back here again!

The apartment is fine . The area is a little noisy from the street, and it’s in an area that’s not Great ...it’s okay ....just its not the most sophisticated area . A good 24 h Supermarket is very close.
Beautiful space, central location, spotless upon arrival and exceptional communication from the host throughout our stay!

Very easy going and super nice from the beginning to the end and also very helpful. The apartment was exactly what we expected from the pictures and the area was also perfect. Everything reachable by walk and/or underground connection. Thanks a lot Gustavo, highly recommend!!!

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment! It was very light and stylish apartment filled with everything you need! Location was good - we even walked to city centre as it was very nice walk to see this area. And we found shopping centre very close to this apartment. Superb! We will defenetely use this apartment again if we stay in Madrid! Thank you so much!!!

Great value, clean, and a quite location from the downtown hustle and bustle. All you could want in a home away from home atmosphere. I would stay here again and recommend this place to family and friends.

This apartment was beautiful and well decorated. Everything looked new and clean. Our hosts were friendly, helpful and worked with us when our arrival time was delayed. There are places to eat nearby and the neighborhood seemed nice. Many of the things to see and do in Madrid are a short cab/uber or bus ride away. It was hot (39C/102F) while we were visiting so we stayed out of the afternoon heat as much as possible by visiting some of the great museums around Madrid.

Chic apartment in a good area of Madrid. Within walking distance to all the major sights. Susanna and Nacho made us feel welcome and gave us useful tourist information. Air conditioning would have made sleeping easier, so if you are not used to the heat or humidity this could be a difficulty.
Lovely, neat, clean apartment that is well located. Host is great and very responsive. I highly recommend this apartment.

Our stay was even better than expected. Really amazing and stylish appartment. Communication went smoothly. Very convenient location as you can walk to almost anything in the city centre. We would definitely be happy to come back or recommend to any of our friends staying in Madrid.

This beautiful space is perfect for a larger group (we had 7) in the heart of downtown Madrid. The living room and dining room were great to relax in and plan our adventure for the day. Great space to stay in.

This is the place! Close to everything. We walked in all directions and saw the beautiful town, then at night we’d come back to the apartment, clean up and saunter out for dinner. The apartment itself is very big and our group of five had plenty of space. Three bathrooms made our large group seem like luxury instead of dormitory. Washer and dryer always make travel easier (yes it was chocolate sauce!) And I love having the fridge. Mornings were coffee and tea in the apartment, yoga (the living room is that big) then off to buy a pastry. We loved Mercado San Miguel and had a great tapas dinner there. That’s a five minute walk.

Juanma's apartment is just as everyone says- perfect location, great for a short stay for a single or couple. It's in close proximity to a few metro stations and it's also easy to walk everywhere around central. Check-in was easy and Juanma was flexible to work around when my flight got in. Would definitely recommend this flat- central Madrid but with the feeling of a nice neighbourhood area!

I wish we could give Maria's apartment a 10 star review. The apartment was easy to access, spacious, comfortable, sparkling clean with an amazing location. Maria was prompt with responses to our questions or concerns. I would recommend her apartment to others and I will stay again in future trips to Madrid.

A great experience of stayed in chueca, l like the atmosphere here. John and his lover are warm hearted and very friendly. l like their dog ，lovely ruben.The room have a good location,you can visit every tourism attractions by foot in 20min. There are many bar and restaurant nearby.
Location, location, location. For the price paid, it is truly in a great location in a really lovely neighbourhood. John is very accommodating and even checked me in a bit earlier.

Perfect big apartment, in case you are staying with a group. We were with 6 and the apartment was defintely big enough. 3 sleeping rooms, one sofa to sleep on, 2 bathrooms. Also the location is great, no issues with traffic sound, and a metrostop around the corner. Also the disco El Kapital is just crossing the street ;) I can definitely recommand to book this apartment if you are searching one in Madrid.

Amazing location, excellent unit, quick responses. Allowed us to check in earlier, only 2 cons are we did not have hot water when we arrived (but it was fixed fast) and there's no storage option upon check-out. I strongly recommend to stay with them for a pleasant visit in Madrid!!!
Fran’s place was spacious, clean and well equipped. The location was ideal to get to the airport the next day. Would highly recommend for accommodation in Madrid.
The landlord is nice and generous. The house is close to the stadium. And the area is nice and quiet.
The appartment is well located and super nice. Alvaro was available for any questions and super kind
Amazing place, Alvaro was lovely and very quick to respond. The house was super well equipped and in what i believe to be the best area in madrid! I had an amazing experience.

We had a nice stay in Alvaro’s apartment and he was a great host as very responsive and kind. A situation happened at check in and he solved it immediately. We had a late flight and he was super accommodating with us on that part so we are very thankful to him! He also provides very interesting recommendations of things around and especially restaurants. The apartment itself is very stylish and the two bathrooms are a must. Bravo Alvaro and thank you very much!

Antonio was an incredible host! His level of responsiveness and concern for his guest(s) is absolutely unmatched. Every detail of this property was spectacular... from the cleanliness, location, check-in and the various amenities that Antonio provided his guest(s). I certainly recommend this property to anyone! Antonio is beyond a doubt a SUPER HOST!

I had a great stay at Isabel’s place! Great location and cute apartment. Apartment was very clean, check-in was easy, great shower as well. Apt is in a great location and close to public transportation.

Small studio but with all the essentials needed: possibility to cook simple meals and also washing machine at our disposition. Ideal for one person but 2 person is ok too which was my case. Great if you work/tour/study and don't stay much at home and just want privacy and independence at night. Supermarkets nearby. Area is in /near Chinatown of madrid. Ramón is contactable through Airbnb app. Excellent check-in and out process - very easy. Thanks Ramón for the stay.

Great location!! Was worried at first about how quiet the street was, if it would be safe at night but the street was nicely lit and we felt safe at all times. 3 floor walk up! Not the end of the world depending on how many bags you have and how heavy they are. Washer/dryer was awesome and we were given a detergent pod :D Apt was super clean! AC worked well. Cooled the apt very quickly. All utensils were available. They even had a charger adapter which came in super handy as we forgot ours! Being that it is an attic, the ceiling in the bathroom is very low. I am 5’6 and I had trouble with it. But my gf is 5’2 and she was fine. Definitely not a deal breaker! The host was super accommodating and responded quickly. Would definitely recommend!

Stayed here for 3 weeks while I was searching for a place to move to permanently in Madrid. The neighborhood is great - lots of bars and restaurants just around the corner. The area has 3-4 metro stops, connecting you to different lines, so the area is great. The apartment is a bit small, but I guess it's pretty normal for the center of Madrid. It had everything I needed - washing machine, dishwasher, airco and heating working very well, a great shower. The kitchen was pretty well equipped as well, so it was all great. The big tv was also a plus, although you can't directly connect it to Netflix, but you can use an HDMI cable and connect another device. The apartment is on the 6th floor, interior views, which also makes it very quiet. No worries, there's an elevator! Definitely recommend this place.
This place is in a good location - close to tours, shopping, metro, market, etc. Maria showed us the place and was very welcoming. Thanks, Maria!

This place is an absolute gem! Right in the centre of one of the city’s most popular and most beautiful districts with great transport links. The apartment is stylish and impeccably clean and Jose made us feel incredibly welcome. Would recommend tenfold!

Everything functioned well! It was very pleasant that Jose met us in person even if we arrived at 1 am. Communication was good and Jose’s place was very freshly decorated and furnished. The location is very central and there are tons of restaurants close by. I can recommend this Airbnb for other couple travellers.

Our stay here was wonderful. The apartment is beautiful and very clean. We found the location to be great for our stay. We were well taken care of by the host, and their communication was superb. Fantastic stay all around, highly reccomend.

Very tidy and lovely AirBnb apartment equipped with everything you need. A very comfortable bed! Andrea is a great host and there when you need her. It’s in a great location, close to metro, restaurants and shops. It’s a perfect size for a couple looking to getaway. We had a great stay! Thank you!
Dans place in Madrid was perfect! Check in was extremely easy and efficient and his extra efforts towards amenities did not go unnoticed!

Emilio's place is right at the Plaza de España, PRIME location. The apartment is compact yet with everything. We requested a stay on the same date of arrival of Madrid during holiday season. Emi responded super quickly and was able to clean/prepare the apartment very nicely on time. His communication is very quick and efficient. Loved the stay and could recommend to singles or couples!
Perfect location, very close to a lot of cozy squares. The apartment itself was amazing, with a lovely balkony.
We had a great stay in Daniel’s apartment, which is stylish, well-equipped and spotless clean. The location is perfect with lots of cozy bars, shops and restaurants. We can definitely recommend it!
